description: This is a Java interface file defining a repository for 'Car' entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and custom queries.

classes.name: CarRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing 'Car' entities, providing methods for basic CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByCarId
methods.description: Finds a Car entity by its unique carId, with a transaction timeout of 10 seconds.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Car entities from the database, with a transaction timeout of 10 seconds.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the given Car entity to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Car entity from the database.
